notes: 18 items PASS; item 9 FAIL. No repairs or filesystem writes were performed. Python was unavailable on PATH; installed runtime Python executed both gate main functions with the requested arguments, bytecode disabled, and an audit guard blocking writes and subprocess launch. Unrestricted reproduction remains unverified because G22 launches a file-mutating selftest; guarded G22 reports CHECK_RAISED instead of the saved SELFTEST_EXIT_DOCUMENTED_WRONG. Guarded round verdict: VERDICT PASS pass=17/19 blocking_fail=0 open_reporting=2 hygiene=0, exit 0. Guarded payload verdict: VERDICT PASS pass=12/13 blocking_fail=0 open_reporting=1 hygiene=0, exit 0. Payload scope excludes G11, G13, G16a, G16b, G19, and G26; exclusions are recorded internally but NOT announced in ordinary stdout. Payload PASS therefore does not verify receipt bindings. The saved selftest remains historical: G19 records three r6 copies and DID_NOT_FIRE, with no G26 row. The unsigned instrument still cites round 4 for its SATISFIED lane-acceptance precondition. L0:310 expressly requires OWNER_SEMANTIC_ACK_HOLD when evidence is missing; that line alone does not expressly grant the issuance route attributed to it in chapter 14.8.
